payload.title: edit tool writes relative paths into the session cwd, not the unit worktree
payload.body: While building tap-uninstall-restores in its own worktree, an edit given a repo-relative path landed in the main checkout (the session cwd), not in the unit worktree; absolute worktree paths landed correctly. The edit was reverted from main. An implementer in a worktree must address files by absolute worktree path unless its cwd is the worktree.
